References Point at Objects

Cash in hand vs address slips. Copying a slip shares the house.

⏱ 15 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Photocopying keys

Copy the slip, share the house.

🏠

House addresses. Two slips can point at ONE house. Primitives = cash in hand; references = slips to heap-houses. A slip reading null points at an empty lot — visiting crashes.

What does b = a share?

Two slips, one string — predict, then reveal.

One house, two slips. Renovate through one (append !), see it through both. To truly clone, build with new.
